G3-AUDIO-001.defect: Accepted backend/update failure could make retry advance local temporal state twice unless the pending delta/result ownership remains authoritative.

G3-AUDIO-002.defect: Cleanup/publication failure could lose cleanup ownership or expose partially committed voice/listener state unless capacity preflight and retryable cleanup state are preserved.

G3-REN-001.defect: Failed AbortFrame must retain explicit recovery ownership and block a new frame until backend reconciliation succeeds.

G3-SUP-001.defect: Scene projection retry must preserve the accepted prefix so already-applied external work is not repeated.

G3-SUP-002.defect: Coordinator retry must retain accepted prefix ownership across a later local/fallible stage.

G3-SUP-003.defect: Event publication failure/exception must be contained without consuming source events or publishing a partial sink batch.

G3-SUP-004.defect: Animation/audio resource lease publication must transfer ownership only after successful publication and retain retry ownership on failure.

G3-SUP-005.defect: Audio lease cleanup/destructor retry must not drop an unreleased accepted resource lease.

G3-SUP-006.defect: Reference audio voice identity must commit only after the corresponding backend/publication work succeeds.

G3-SUP-007.defect: Animation pose publication must be atomic so a failing publication does not replace authoritative pose state.

M3C-SCENE-001.defect: Sphere/AABB intersection squared large finite float distances and radius in binary32; both sides could overflow to infinity and make a non-intersection compare as inf <= inf.

M3C-SUP-001.defect: Duplicate renderer registration previously called EnsureMainView before duplicate-service rejection and could mutate Scene revision on an ultimately failing registration.
